title: The Patents Rules, 2003 (as amended by Patents (Amendment) Rules, 2024)
authority: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (DPIIT) / IP India

rules.heading: Statement and Undertaking Regarding Foreign Applications (Section 8)
rules.text: Under the 2024 Amendment Rules, the requirement to periodically file foreign prosecution details on Form 3 has been streamlined to reduce compliance burden on startups and MSMEs.
rules.relevance: Procedural compliance for AYUSH global filings.

rules.heading: Expedited Examination of Patent Applications
rules.text: An applicant may file a request for expedited examination on Form 18A where the applicant is a recognized startup, small entity, or an application involving Department of Biotechnology/AYUSH recognized research organizations.
rules.relevance: Enables AYUSH startups to get examination reports within months instead of years.

rules.heading: Opposition Procedure (Pre-Grant)
rules.text: Streamlined pre-grant opposition hearing mechanisms to prevent frivolous biopiracy patents on indigenous traditional medicinal herbs.

rules.heading: Concessional Fees for Startups and Educational Institutions
rules.text: Significant fee reductions (up to 80% discount on filing, examination and renewal) for DPIIT-recognized startups and universities developing herbal innovations.
